integrity: A self-contained constructive proof is supplemented by 505 exact rational kernel-eigenvalue tests. The tests are corroboration, not proof for unbounded dimensions. No external mathematical certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Dimension at least six; individual harmonic degrees zero through d+2 only. Rank and images, not singular-value sizes or conditioning. Foundational related articles are not all available in full; historical originality remains uncertain.
title: Walsh blind spots in cubical sampling of individual spherical-harmonic degrees
